basic_info.description: Welcome to 1125 18th St Unit 2, a charming condo nestled in the heart of Potrero Hill. This beautifully remodeled unit offers a seamless blend of modern amenities and classic details. This one-bedroom, one-bathroom layout is complemented by hardwood floors and intricate molding, creating an inviting atmosphere. Enjoy the warmth of the living room fireplace and open the door to the tranquil shared outdoor space, perfect for relaxation or social gatherings. The bedroom features large closet and custom desk that looks out onto city views. The kitchen is equipped with premium Bertazzoni, Fisher & Paykel, and Bosch appliances, ensuring a top-tier culinary experience. Bathroom enjoys soaking tub and separate shower. Located on vibrant 18th Street, this property is steps away to local shops, dining and entertainment, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a dynamic urban lifestyle. Easy access to UCSF Medical Center, 280 and public transportation. Experience the perfect combination of comfort and convenience in this exceptional San Francisco home.
